design: At each iteration compute full separately normalized family gradients and horizontal tangent unit-gradient-sum direction. First step in descending fixed grid satisfying Armijo decrease for BOTH training losses is accepted; validation never selects step length. Eight-iteration maximum, six trials/iteration maximum. Retraction QR. Select maximum worst-family validation checkpoint including step0; no new seed/feature/rank.

gates.validation_both_gain: selected validation fidelity gain>=2pp actual AND angle vs proxy
gates.monotone_train: every accepted step nondecreasing in both training fidelities

scope: Local optimizer diagnostic, existing validation selection only. Training monotonicity is algorithm audit, not generalization. No convergence/global optimum claim on budget stop. No fresh or intact eval.
